#  11488 - German as a Foreign Language - A1, Part 2 Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11488 - module is no longer offered from SS 2021**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **German as a Foreign Language - A1, Part 2**  |  
|  Deutsch als Fremdsprache - A1, Teil 2   |  
| Department:  |  ZES - Language Centre   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Brachmann, Katja 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | At the end of the module the participant can understand and use familiar everyday expressions and very basic phrases aimed at the satisfaction of needs of a concrete type, e. g. in a shop or restaurant. He/she can introduce him/herself and others and can ask and answer basic questions about personal details such as where he/she lives and things he/she has. He/she can interact in a simple way provided the other person talks slowly and clearly and is prepared to help.  |  
| Contents:  | Main topics: 
  * Daily routine
  * Making an appointment
  * Seasons and weather
  * Travelling
  * Living
  * Congratulation and birthday presents
  * Health

Exercises: 
  * Listening comprehension, dialogues, reading comprehension, production of short texts

Grammatical aspects: 
  * Verbs (perfect: regular and irregular), verbs with prefixes (separable / inseparable), various verb conjugations (imperative, future, preterite)
  * Modal verbs (must, want, may); modal verbs in preterite
  * Conjunctions (and, or, then, but)
  * Declination (nouns, pronouns)
  * Stating position and direction (two way prepositions)
  * Adjectives: comparative

 |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  |  Strongly recommended:
  * Module 11487  _German as a Foreign Language - A1, Part 1_

Placement test at the start of the course.  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Seminar / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 60 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Begegnungen A1+, Schubert Verlag (combined course and work book), units 5 - 8

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Continuous Assessment (MCA)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * 4 tests a 60 minutes
  * The result of each test counts 25 % for the module grade

 |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |
